acquire.valid_rule: dispatcher asserts only actual engine command acceptance; ready/error are combinational eligibility independent of valid; valid&&ready commits all used banks same edge

producer.rule: begin destination update only matching acquired bank/transaction/role/original generation; new generation=accepted+1 nonwrapping; validate shape/profile; clear data/scale and embedding flags; acquired generation remains original for response/release

arbitration: No rejected metadata or ownership event mutates state. Disjoint acquire/release may coexist.
